titleEn: Basement Renovation Cost Vancouver 2026: Real Numbers From $50K to $350K
titleZh: 温哥华地下室装修成本 2026：真实数据从 5 万到 35 万加元
contentEn:
Vancouver basement renovation costs in 2026 range from $50,000 for basic finishing to $350,000 or more for a premium legal secondary suite. The wide range reflects real choices: whether you are finishing a rec room for your family or pulling permits for a fully self-contained rental suite with its own kitchen, bathroom, and separate entrance. This guide breaks down every cost tier, the BC Building Code requirements that drive pricing, and what separates a $50K basement from one that costs three times as much.

How Much Does a Basement Renovation Cost in Vancouver?

A basement renovation in Vancouver costs $50,000–$90,000 for basic finishing with no bathroom, $80,000–$130,000 when you add a three-piece bathroom, $130,000–$200,000 for a legal one-bedroom secondary suite, and $180,000–$350,000+ for a two-bedroom legal suite with an ensuite for the primary homeowner. These are not estimates — they are the actual price ranges from Reno Stars projects completed in Metro Vancouver in 2025–2026, inclusive of permits, BC Building Code compliance, and all trades.

2026 Vancouver Basement Cost Breakdown by Tier

Every basement project starts with a written scope and a fixed-price contract. Here is what you get at each investment level:

  • Basic finishing ($50,000–$90,000): Drywall, electrical, LED lighting, flooring, paint, baseboards, and one optional rec room area. No bathroom, no kitchen. No permit required unless you are adding a bedroom.
  • Finishing plus one bathroom ($80,000–$130,000): Everything above plus a three-piece bathroom rough-in and finish. Suitable for a home gym, media room, or teenage retreat.
  • Legal one-bedroom secondary suite ($130,000–$200,000): Full kitchen, three-piece bathroom, separate entrance, fire separation between units, egress windows, and a separate electrical panel. This is the minimum scope for a code-compliant rental unit in BC.
  • Legal two-bedroom suite with ensuite ($180,000–$280,000): Two bedrooms with code-compliant egress, full kitchen, two bathrooms including an ensuite for the primary unit, premium finishes throughout, and soundproofing between units.
  • Premium suite plus entertainment area ($200,000–$350,000+): Wet bar, home theatre, gym, sauna, premium millwork, and designer finishes. For homeowners who want their basement to function as a separate entertainment wing.

Reno Stars has managed basement renovation projects across Surrey, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, and Vancouver. Every project includes BC Building Code §9.36 permits, fire separation per §9.10, $5 million CGL insurance, WorkSafeBC coverage, and a three-year workmanship warranty. All pricing reflects 2026 Metro Vancouver trade rates and municipal fee schedules.

What Drives Vancouver Basement Costs Above the $50K Floor?

The $50,000 floor is the minimum for a code-compliant basement in Vancouver in 2026. Several pre-existing conditions in older Metro Vancouver homes routinely add $10,000–$80,000 to project costs:

ConditionImpactAdded Cost
Ceiling height under 7 feetRequires underpinning to lower the basement floor+$30,000–$80,000
Knob-and-tube wiringMust be fully replaced before closing walls+$10,000–$25,000
Asbestos in popcorn ceiling or pipe insulationRequires certified abatement before demo+$5,000–$25,000
Egress window cut in concrete foundationRequired for bedrooms in a suite+$3,000–$6,000 each
Separate electrical panel and meterRequired for separate utility billing in a suite+$4,000–$8,000
Active water leak or failed exterior membraneRequires exterior excavation and new waterproofing+$25,000–$60,000
Interior dampness or musty smellInterior dimple board and drainage to sump required+$4,000–$12,000

BC Building Code Requirements for a Legal Secondary Suite

A basement suite is legal in British Columbia only when it meets all of the following requirements, each of which adds cost that a non-permitted renovation skips:

  • Fire separation: 5/8-inch Type X drywall on the basement ceiling with all penetrations smoke-sealed. This is non-negotiable and inspectors check it before drywall is closed.
  • Interconnected smoke and CO alarms: Hardwired throughout both the main unit and the suite, with the alarms linked so that a fire in either unit sounds both.
  • Egress windows in every bedroom: Minimum 0.35 square metres of clear opening, at least 0.55 metres wide, with the sill no more than 1 metre above the floor. Concrete foundation cuts for egress windows typically cost $3,000–$6,000 each.
  • Separate entrance: Must open directly to the outside with no shared corridor with the main unit. Interior stairs into a shared foyer do not satisfy this requirement.
  • Sound transmission rating STC 50+: Floor/ceiling assembly between the two units must achieve STC 50 or higher, typically through layers of drywall and acoustic insulation.
  • Ventilation per BC §9.32: Bathroom and kitchen exhaust must vent directly to the exterior — not into a common vent stack shared with the main unit in a way that transfers cooking odour.

How Long Does a Basement Renovation Take in Vancouver?

Basement renovation timelines in Vancouver vary by scope and by municipality permit timelines. City of Vancouver and City of Surrey both currently have extended permit processing times for secondary suite applications. The construction durations are:

  • Basic finishing: 6–10 weeks of construction, plus 2–6 weeks for permit approval if a bedroom is added.
  • Finishing plus one bathroom: 8–12 weeks of construction.
  • Legal one-bedroom secondary suite: 12–18 weeks of construction, with permit timelines adding 4–12 weeks depending on the municipality.
  • Legal two-bedroom suite with ensuite: 16–22 weeks of construction, with the most complex permit reviews.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, or whole-home renovation at the same time as your basement project can reduce total timeline and save on mobilization costs, since trades are already on site.

Waterproofing Costs for Vancouver Basements

Vancouver's high water table and clay soil create basement moisture challenges that do not exist in drier climates. Before any finishing work begins, a moisture assessment identifies which waterproofing solution is needed:

  • Interior dimple board and sump drainage: For basements with existing dampness or musty smell. Routes water to a sump pump before it reaches finished walls. Cost: $4,000–$12,000.
  • Interior spray foam and dehumidifier system: For basements with active leakage or efflorescence on foundation walls. Cost: $6,000–$18,000.
  • Exterior excavation and new waterproofing membrane: Required when exterior grading directs water toward the foundation or when an exterior membrane has failed. Cost: $25,000–$60,000. This is the most disruptive option and is typically done during exterior landscaping work.

Is a $35,000 Basement Renovation Possible in Vancouver?

No — not if the work is permitted, code-compliant, and insurable. A $35,000 Vancouver basement renovation in 2026 requires skipping at least one of the following: building permits, fire separation, egress windows, separate entrance, or trade insurance. Each of these omissions creates a specific and serious risk. An unpermitted suite cannot be rented legally, voids your home insurance in a claim, and will be flagged during any future resale inspection. Reno Stars does not do unpermitted basement work. Our $50,000 floor reflects 2026 BC trade rates plus permit costs plus code-compliant materials — not a discount for cutting corners.

Frequently Asked Questions — Basement Renovation Cost Vancouver

How much does a basement renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A basic basement finishing project in Vancouver costs $50,000–$90,000. Adding a three-piece bathroom brings the total to $80,000–$130,000. A legal one-bedroom secondary suite with a separate entrance, full kitchen, and code-compliant fire separation ranges from $130,000–$200,000. A two-bedroom legal suite with an ensuite for the primary homeowner costs $180,000–$280,000. Premium basement renovations with home theatre, wet bar, or gym finish at $200,000–$350,000 or more.

Do I need a permit for a basement renovation in Vancouver?

Yes. Building permits are required for any bedroom addition, bathroom addition, separate entrance creation, structural changes such as underpinning, and all work required to create a legal secondary suite. Electrical permits and plumbing permits are separate from the building permit and are pulled concurrently. Reno Stars prepares and files the complete BC Building Code §9.36 permit package and coordinates all municipal inspections.

What is required to make a basement suite legal in BC?

A legal secondary suite in British Columbia requires: a separate entrance with direct access to the outside, minimum ceiling height of 6 feet 5 inches under beams for habitable rooms, interconnected hardwired smoke and carbon monoxide alarms in both units, 5/8-inch Type X drywall fire separation on the basement ceiling, egress windows in every bedroom meeting the 0.35 square metre clear opening requirement, STC 50+ floor/ceiling assembly between units, bathroom and kitchen exhaust venting direct to exterior, and a municipal building permit with inspection sign-off from the local city.

How long does a basement renovation take in Vancouver?

A basic basement finishing project takes 6–10 weeks of construction. A legal secondary suite conversion takes 12–18 weeks of construction plus 4–12 weeks of permit approval time depending on the municipality. A two-bedroom legal suite with ensuite, premium finishes, and structural work runs 16–22 weeks of construction with the longest permit queue times. Reno Stars coordinates all trades under a single project manager and provides weekly photo documentation throughout.

Can I do a basement renovation and a kitchen renovation at the same time?

Yes — and it is often cheaper to do both together. Mobilizing a general contractor once covers both scopes, and many of the same trades (electricians, plumbers, drywallers) work on both projects. Coordinating a basement suite with a main-floor kitchen and bathroom refresh typically saves 15–25 percent in mobilization and overhead costs compared to running the projects separately.

We cover basement renovation projects across Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, Burnaby, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, New Westminster, Delta, Langley, Port Moody, Maple Ridge, White Rock, and Port Coquitlam.

2026 年温哥华地下室装修成本范围从基本装修的 5 万加元到高级法律套房的 35 万加元以上。广泛的成本范围反映了真实的选择：您是为家人完成一个娱乐室，还是在获取许可证的情况下建造一个配有独立厨房、浴室和独立入口的完全自足的出租套房。本指南详细分析了每个成本等级、驱动定价的 BC 建筑规范要求，以及区分 5 万加元地下室和成本三倍之高的地下室的具体差异。

温哥华地下室装修一般多少钱？

温哥华地下室装修费用为 5 万至 9 万加元（无浴室的基本装修）、8 万至 13 万加元（增加三件套浴室）、13 万至 20 万加元（法律一居室次要套房）、18 万至 35 万加元以上（带套间的两居室法律套房）。这些不是估计数字——而是来自 Reno Stars 于 2025 年至 2026 年在 Metro Vancouver 完成的项目的实际价格范围，包括许可证、BC 建筑规范合规性和所有行业费用。

2026 年温哥华地下室成本明细（按等级）

每个地下室项目都从书面范围和固定价格合同开始。以下是每个投资级别包含的内容：

  • 基本整理（5 万至 9 万加元）：干墙、电气、LED 照明、地板、油漆、踢脚板以及一个可选的娱乐室区域。无浴室，无厨房。除非增加卧室，否则不需要许可证。
  • 整理加一间浴室（8 万至 13 万加元）：上述所有内容加三件套浴室毛坯和饰面。适用于家庭健身房、媒体室或青少年休息室。
  • 法律一居室次要套房（13 万至 20 万加元）：设施齐全的厨房、三件套浴室、独立入口、单元之间的防火隔离、出口窗户和独立配电板。这是 BC 法律出租单元的最低合规范围。
  • 带套间的法律两居室套房（18 万至 28 万加元）：两间卧室，均配有合规的出口通道、设施齐全的厨房、两间浴室（包括主单元的套间）、各处的优质饰面以及单元之间的隔音设施。
  • 高级套房加娱乐区（20 万至 35 万加元以上：吧台、家庭影院、健身房、桑拿房、优质木制品和设计师饰面。适用于希望其地下室作为独立娱乐翼运行的业主。

Reno Stars 已在 Surrey、Richmond、Burnaby、Coquitlam 和 Vancouver 管理地下室装修项目。每个项目均包含 BC 建筑规范 §9.36 许可证、按 §9.10 进行防火分隔、500 万加元的 CGL 保险、WorkSafeBC 覆盖范围以及 3 年的工艺保修。所有价格均反映 2026 年 Metro Vancouver 的行业费率和大市政收费表。

是什么驱动温哥华地下室成本超过 5 万加元的底线？

5 万加元是 2026 年温哥华合规地下室装修的最低费用。较旧的 Metro Vancouver 房屋中的几个现有条件通常会额外增加 1 万至 8 万加元的项目成本：

条件影响增加成本
天花板低于 7 英尺需要支撑以降低地下室地板+3 万至 8 万加元
旋钮和管布线在关闭墙壁之前必须完全更换+1 万至 2.5 万加元
爆米花天花板或管道保温中的石棉在拆除前需要认证的减排处理+5,000 至 2.5 万加元
混凝土基础中的出口窗户切割套房中卧室必须+3,000 至 6,000 加元/个
独立配电板和电表套房独立计费需要+4,000 至 8,000 加元
主动漏水或外部防水膜失效需要外部开挖和新防水+2.5 万至 6 万加元
室内潮湿或霉味需要室内凹坑板和排水至污水坑+4,000 至 1.2 万加元

法律次要套房的 BC 建筑规范要求

地下室套房只有在满足以下所有要求的情况下才能在 BC 合法，每个要求都会增加非许可装修省掉的成本：

  • 防火分隔：地下室天花板上的 5/8 英寸 X 型干墙，所有渗透点防烟密封。这是硬性要求，验房师在干墙封闭之前进行检查。
  • 互连的烟雾和一氧化碳报警器：在整个主单元和套房中硬连线，两个单元中任何一个发生火灾都会触发两个单元的警报。
  • 每间卧室的出口窗户：最小净开口 0.35 平方米，至少 0.55 米宽，门槛距地面不超过 1 米。混凝土基础出口窗户切割每个通常需要 3,000 至 6,000 加元。
  • 独立入口：必须直接向外打开，不得与主单元共用走廊。通向共用门厅的室内楼梯不满足此要求。
  • 声音传播等级 STC 50+：两个单元之间的地板/天花板组件必须达到 STC 50 或更高，通常通过干墙层和隔音保温实现。
  • 按 BC §9.32 通风：浴室和厨房排气必须直接排至室外——而不是以某种方式通过共用通风井将烹饪气味传递到主单元。

温哥华地下室装修需要多长时间？

温哥华地下室装修时间线因装修范围和市政许可证时间线而异。Vancouver 市和 Surrey 市目前对次要套房申请的许可证处理时间都较长。施工时间如下：

  • 基本整理：施工 6–10 周，如果增加卧室则额外增加 2–6 周许可证审批时间。
  • 整理加一间浴室：施工 8–12 周。
  • 法律一居室次要套房：施工 12–18 周，加上许可证审批时间（因市政当局而异）额外增加 4–12 周。
  • 带套间的法律两居室套房：施工 16–22 周，许可证审查时间最长。

同时规划厨房、浴室或全屋装修与地下室项目可以减少总时间线并节省动员成本，因为各行业承包商已经在现场。

正在规划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？获取 Reno Stars 的免费、无义务报价。

温哥华地下室防水成本

温哥华的高地下水位和粘土土壤造成了温哥华地下室特有的潮湿问题，这是较干燥气候中不存在的问题。在任何整理工作开始之前，潮湿评估会确定需要哪种防水解决方案：

  • 室内凹坑板和污水坑排水：适用于已有潮湿或霉味的地下室。在水达到装修墙壁之前将其引导至污水坑。成本：4,000 至 1.2 万加元。
  • 室内发泡保温和除湿系统：适用于有主动漏水或地基墙上有风化的地下室。成本：6,000 至 1.8 万加元。
  • 外部开挖和新防水膜：当地面坡度将水引向地基或外部膜失效时需要。成本：2.5 万至 6 万加元。这是破坏性最大的方案，通常在外部园林绿化工程期间进行。

温哥华 3.5 万加元的地下室装修可能吗？

不——如果工程是有许可的、符合法规的并且可投保的话，则不可能。2026 年 5 万加元的底线反映了 2026 年 BC 行业费率加上许可证费用加上合规材料——而不是通过偷工减料获得的折扣。省钱的装修必须跳过以下至少一项：建筑许可证、防火分隔、出口窗户、独立入口或承包商保险。每一项遗漏都会产生具体而严重的风险。无证套房不能合法出租，在索赔时会取消您的房屋保险，并在未来转售检查时被标记。Reno Stars 不做无证地下室工程。

常见问题解答 — 温哥华地下室装修成本

2026 年温哥华地下室装修一般多少钱？

温哥华基本地下室整理项目的费用为 5 万至 9 万加元。增加三件套浴室将总费用提高至 8 万至 13 万加元。配有独立入口、设施齐全厨房和合规防火分隔的法律一居室次要套房费用为 13 万至 20 万加元。主业主要套间的两居室法律套房费用为 18 万至 28 万加元。带家庭影院、吧台或健身房的优质地下室装修费用为 20 万至 35 万加元或更高。

温哥华地下室装修需要许可证吗？

是的。建筑许可证是针对以下情况所必需的：增加卧室、增加浴室、创建独立入口、支撑等结构性变更，以及创建法律次要套房的所有工程。电气许可证和管道许可证与建筑许可证分开，并同时提取。Reno Stars 准备并提交完整的 BC 建筑规范 §9.36 许可包，并协调所有市政检查。

在 BC 使地下室套房合法需要什么？

BC 的合法次要套房需要：直接通向室外的独立入口、起居空间横梁下最小净空高度 6 英尺 5 英寸、两个单元中互连的硬连线烟雾和一氧化碳探测器、地下室天花板上的 5/8 英寸 X 型干墙防火分隔、每间卧室的出口窗户（满足 0.35 平方米净开口要求）、单元之间 STC 50+ 地板/天花板组件、直接排至室外的浴室和厨房排气，以及当地城市的市政建筑许可证和检查签核。

温哥华地下室装修需要多长时间？

基本地下室整理项目需要 6–10 周的施工时间。法律次要套房改造需要 12–18 周的施工时间，加上 4–12 周的许可证批准时间（取决于市政当局）。带套间、优质饰面和结构工程的合法两居室套房需要 16–22 周的施工时间，许可证排队时间最长。Reno Stars 在单一项目经理下协调所有行业，并全程提供每周照片记录。

我可以在同一时间进行地下室装修和厨房装修吗？

是的——而且同时进行通常更便宜。一次动员总承包商同时覆盖两个范围，许多相同的行业（电工、水管工、干墙工）都在两个项目上工作。将地下室套房与主楼层厨房和浴室翻新一起协调通常比单独运行项目可节省 15–25% 的动员和管理费用。
